ListViewBaseName

This is the base part of a ListView name when generated by a property field. Just add the name of the property list being shown by the ListView with a dash in front of it to get the Unity generated name of the ListView. Example a List of a C# object called WeaponProperties will be name unity-list-WeaponProperties
